notes.title: Back from vacation + Patch notes
notes.content:
I'm back everyone! Vacation was great and i'm now pumped to get Loya in a demo ready state! 

Once the demo is up and ready I will start working on the other 3 regions!



Of course I also took some time to work on Loya while i was on vacation, here are the latest changes:


Repair system changes
We need a cost for auto repair, by making it free, player can just use the base as a permanent shield. If the player defends with the base to kill monsters, he needs to pay a price. To avoid softlock, we still allow buildings to be repaired for free at the first hp.

Repairing should drain Energy, first hp should be free, then it should cost 1 Energy per 100 hp.

Feeding core triggers the autorepair if base is damaged.

A message now warn the player that auto repair needs Energy to fully restore buildings.
New base->world collision system
Your buildings now take damage if they collide with the environement.

Your building do damage to trees when they collide with them.
Game feel/Combat
Fixed some animations where the attack animation was faster that the slash effect

Fixed jump animation, it will no longer play the run animation while on air

When you roll, your character is highlighed showing IFrame duration
QOL
During the tutorial, the crafting table is now highlighted in the Building UI (Tab)

If you have completed the tutorial and don't have a core, it will be highllighted in the building UI 

The feeding UI action button shows 'Evolve' when the core is ready to be upgraded

notes.title: Vacation! + Patch notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

After 3 month of non stop developing, it's time for a vacation! I'll be leaving Paris to go to Chicago for 3 weeks!  

Although I really want to keep working on the game, I wont be able to for a little while, but I also need to rest so it's probably a good thing.

Patch notes:
Now let's talk about Build 237 

A good game is not just its ideas, it's also how these ideas are implemented. Recently, I have been focused on improving UI clarity, adding "Juice" and making the combat feel more responsive.


QOL - Combat:
Added a subtle camera shake when you hit a target

Animation stops for a few frames when you hit a target

When you take damage, your character becomes red for a small amount of time

When you hit an ennemy, they get highlighted for a tiny moment

Damage numbers are bigger, have a "pop" effect and spawn at the right spot

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/26658268f67eec3128fbd4707f4cee22161e873b.png"]
QOL - UI:
Game messages now "pop" when a game error message is showed (ex: Out of energy!)

World map now displays zone names and level ranges

Added sounds on mouse over/click for most Interactable UI elements (buttons etc..)

Changed the Font for the Announcer UI to "Cinzel"

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/c2bd77ba6d21d2a91762fca8e64f4dda5602c0e7.png"]
QOL - Crafting table:
Crafting items is now instant

When you hover the "Craft" button, if you cannot make the item, the reason why will be displayed (missing items or core tier too low)

During the intro tutorial, the "Wooden Axe" is now highlighted until you make a "Wooden Axe"

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/f85cdbd7ab1d8436445775cfb870324bc822e10c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/e3543573152cf27eebf965f9e1635d0ef59d26a4.png"]
QOL - Forge:
Forge items tooltip now shows the min and max stats for the item
QOL - World Codex:
Items or building that require a specific core tier will now show it in the codex.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/3afa2237a64e880b33bf4a874d0d1dd752818df4.png"]
"Mysterious slime":
When a player dies, in some contexts a "Mysterious slime" will appear to help the player. (Ex: If the player dies in a dungeon without forged items, the slime will appear explaining the player that he needs to make a Forge)

Added spawn conditions for the slime on: Dungeon death, Fall death, Cold/Heat death, High level zone death
Game changes:
You can now use canons at full power on normal enemies, but canons only work on biomes whose dungeon you have cleared.

Added a new building: Training target, shows how much DPS (damage you per seconds) you do when you hit it.

Added an extra tutorial step to tell the player to look at the codex objectives at the end of the quick intro tutorial



I'm not including the dozens of bugfixes but there were a lot!

I also fixed some performance issues killing fps in some areas and generating freezes. 

Thank you for testing! I'll add more people when I come back! I'm excited about adding the next biomes.


See you in 3 weeks!

notes.title: Patch notes: Build 177
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/60885f33ce24150c255bf1c0a93a3f8987ad6c97.png"]

With the game's core gameplay loop defined, and the elements that give it depth in place, it's time to focus a on adding some missing systems, fixing bugs and improving the polish and "feel" of the game.

Giants now collide with buildings and players when they are roaming. They do 250 damage per collision.

You can now hear giants! Giants now make stomping noises when they move. It also shakes the ground. They also roar sometimes.

Hitting an enemy with a weapon now pauses the animation for 0.5sec and shakes the camera a bit.

Changed the bottom right UI icons for the menu, inventory etc...

Increased iron density in moutain biome

Campfire now regens 1hp + 1% maxhp every second

You now respawn in the last bed you claimed.

You can not longer place beds on your core

Reduced experience gains after lvl 5

You now always spawn on a "Four statues Monument" when you take the teleporter to leave the Lost portal

Bugs/Issues:

Fixed a performance issue in mushoom biome where the dust motes emitters would accumulate.

Fixed a bug where attacking an enemy would not register in the right position

Fixed an issue where npcs would not spawn unless you would be very close to them

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/8be714c6331de347d4f718756848c80035593475.png"]Hello everyone!

It’s been an incredibly busy couple of months, and I'm thrilled to share the massive progress made on Loya. Your feedback has been invaluable, and based on it, I’ve focused on making the game a cohesive and meaningful adventure.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/b97ab06b405735b6416b2acfcca6a6df0df77e17.png"]

The Living Core: A New Way to Grow

The biggest change is a fundamental redesign of how you upgrade your mobile fortress. The old system didnt really make use of upgrading the core until very late and only required one item. Now, your Core is a living creature that you must nurture.

Feed the Core: Instead of using one specific item, you can now feed your Core almost any item you find in the world! From wood and stone to rare monster parts, each item contributes to your Core’s growth.

Organic Progression: Your Core will evolve through multiple tiers, unlocking new abilities like walking, charging, and more. This makes exploration feel incredibly rewarding, as every biome holds new "food" to empower your base.

Energy: No more energy cubes. Now, feeding your Core is the primary way to restore its energy, creating a seamless loop of exploring, gathering, and recharging.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/df77293c72f9afb3964571f234b763093ab28b87.png"]

The main Guide: The World Codex

I have removed the intrusive, linear quest log from the top-left of the screen. Your primary guide is now the World Codex, a dynamic in-game encyclopedia that you fill out yourself.

Discover, Don't Follow: As you interact with the world—by fighting monsters, discovering biomes, or crafting items—you'll unlock detailed Codex entries. These entries provide lore, hints on where to find rare materials, and track your major objectives.

A New Beginning: To introduce this new system, all players will now start on the Lost Portal. Your goal is clear: discover the secrets of this world, grow strong enough to leave, and find your way home.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/7e7c52a703b15961b314b52f79765df0fc10db19.png"]Deeper Systems, Meaningful Choices

I wanted to give more depth and strategic choice to the game.

The Forge: The forge is no longer a simple minigame. It is now the central hub for creating dozens of unique weapons, shields, and armor sets. Gear no longer drops from monsters; you must explore the world to find the resources and forge the equipment you need to survive.

A More Dangerous World: Biomes have been completely rebalanced. The Mushroom Forest is now a vast, dangerous region, and rare resources like Iron have been moved to the treacherous Mountains, giving you a real reason to push into more challenging areas.

Smarter Combat: Giants no longer attack players on sight and can only be damaged by your Core's turrets, reinforcing the core purpose of your mobile fortress. Overall combat responsiveness has also been polished to feel smoother and more impactful.

And So Much More...

Alongside these huge system changes, countless bugs have been squashed and I added a ton of Quality-of-Life improvements, including:

Overhauling UI elements for clarity, including the crafting table and furnace.

Fixing major progression blockers related to quests and item drops.

Improving camera controls and player movement.

This has been a very intense period of development, laying a rock-solid foundation for the future. The game is now more stable, more intuitive, and infinitely more rewarding. The playtests will keep going for a while, if you want to try the game, join the discord and let me know!

Thank you for your continued support on this incredible journey.

notes.title: Patch 0.329a
notes.content:
The game was a lacking a little bit in immersion, asking you to punch trees without a reason.
I'm adding an intro mission that should bring a little more context and combat before switching to the crafting part.

- Added a new starting quest when you create a new character. You now start in the Autumn biome.
- Added a new npc that gives you your mission when you create a new character, he disappears after the start quest.
- The autumn biome has beed added back to the world map, it found east.
- Added chains of mountains around biomes that are not the autumn biome.
- Added random noise to the permanent snow line in mountains.
- Reduced fall damage by 50%
- Added a new quest objective type: "Death"
- Added the "Mysterious Man" npc.

- Fixed a bug with the ice biome main quest where there was no indicator for the village's position.

notes.title: Patch 0.326a: Ice biome
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/a06194e2faae56d553d10ffae4f1fdeefd94a70b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/6ce6beec90298722f25cd8fdf5e58d6d8d65a0ec.jpg

The ice biome is now playable! Most quests have been added and the world bosses are now done for the forest and ice biomes! I'm also adding 200 extra playtesters, your feedback is appreciated!

New:
- Added a new npc: Spirit of the Mountain, he follows you and guides you in your quest in the Ice biome.
- Added a new npc: Armored Titan. A variant of Titan in the ice biome that was turned into a war machine.
- Added 6 new skills, These are skills used by world bosses:
	
    Arcane focus: Focuses your energy, the next spell will do extra damage.
 	Boulders Rain: Fires salves of giant boulders at a target zone. The boulders stay for while modifying the landscape.
 	Giant Stomp: Stomps the ground with a giant feet, shaking the ground and doing massive aoe damage knocking back everyone around. Does extra damage to trees and buildings.
 	Hand Swipe: Use your giant hands to wreak havok. Leaves a trail of rocks.
 	Giant rockets: Fires 20 rockets from each canon in the Armored titan. The rockets do aoe damage on hit and clear the snow on hit.
 	Ice Hurricane: Blows everything in front of the Armored titan, pushing them away.

- Added a new village in the ice biome.
- Added the following upgrades:
	
 Wooden wall chunk -> Reinforced wooden wall (+250 hp)
 	Wooden roof -> Tiled roof (+250 hp)
 	Chest -> Enchanted chest (+8 slots)

- Added a new item: Ring of the North: makes you immune to the environemental freezing effect.
- Added 2 quests:
	
 main quest: ice biome, it contains 10 missions.
 Added the quest: An Alchemist's request.

- Added a cave for the Alchemist's quest.
- Added the following quest objective types: Save Core, Upgrade Building, Reach Supply level, Go to zone with Core
- Added the /kill and /provoke commands to help with debugging.

Changes:
- Titan, the giant golem now has new skills and can be killed.
- Changed the terrain layout in the ice biome. It should be easier to navigate.
- Changed the minimap UI, the contour should be lighter.
- The death recap ui now aggregates environmental damages to make it easier to read.
- You now have all your spells immediately when you unlock a class.
- Chests models now has an open/close animation when you use them (client sided for now)
- Some quests can now enable item drops for a specific area.
- Some npcs can now spawn and follow you at specific contexts such as quests or regions.
- All global entities now attack bases that are too close to them. This includes the titans and the giant desert worm.
- The core and some other buildings now have a particle effect when they are destroyed.
- The statue of memories also protects you from the cold, burn and drown effects.

Bugs:
- Fixed a bug with procedural villages and the mountain terrain now being disabled inside houses.
- Fixed a bug where monsters would walk very close to you even if they were ranged.
- Fixed an issue with animations where the character would feel like it's sliding after a jump
- Fixed a bug where starting a jump would have a delay adding into the sliding feeling.
- Fixed a bug where the landing animation would not be called after a skill.
- Fixed a bug where the server response would no longer be displayed in the world selection ui.
- Fixed a bug with global entities rotation not being properly in sync with the server
- Fixed a bug with combat cycles where the cycle would not start from the first step.
- Fixed a bug with the ancient golem where his rumble skill would not work in dungeons.
- Fixed a bug where the end chest and portals would not spawn when compelting a dungeon.
- Fixed a bug where you would not be able to open chests or containers in dungeons.
- Fixed a bug preventing the player from validating the "Sprinting" quest
- Fixed a bug where the tooltips of quest reward items would not be displayed.
- Fixed a bug with the plasma canon preventing you from using it.
- Fixed a bug with batteries not sharing energy with other components.
- Fixed a bug with the aggro table being locked if the target was destroyed.
- Fixed a bug where some walls/floors would have the wrong rotation due to the shaking effect on hit not being properly destroyed.

notes.content:
I wanted to focus on fixing bugs this week.
It took me two days but I finally managed to fix the bug where some walls in your base would disappear! 
I added 200 more playtesters, if you get the chance to test the game, let me know how it went via discord or the steam forums, it helps me improve the game!

Bug Fixes:


 Fixed a bug where some building would not be properly loading when you left your base and came back.
 Fixed a bug with ladders where you could not climb on them if they were behind you.
 Fixed a bug where you would not be able to interact with players if they standed too close to you.
 Fixed a bug with dedicated servers where raids and pets would not function.
 Fixed a bug with monsters spawns where they would be reloaded each time instead of using the pool, a cause for freezes and memory leaks.
 Fixed a bug with the stone windowed wall where the LOD would trigger too early.
 Fixed a bug where your character's legs IK would sometimes attach to the ceiling.
 Fixed some issues with monsters going underground.


Changes:

 Replaced the overlay ui for the minimap

I added 200 new playtesters, if you have the chance to play, let me know how it went, it helps me improve the game!

Environmental damage sources will no longer be shown as "fall damage" in death recap

notes.title: Patch 0.309a
notes.content:
With this patch, we are done with adding features to the game!
It's now all about finding the balance and timings for these mechanics to make things enjoyable and not overwhelming for the players.

New Dungeon

 The first version of the dungeon "Lost tomb" is done!
 Added a new UI before you enter a dungeon, allows you to choose up to 8 items to take with you when you enter a dungeon.
 Added spike traps that deal physical damage to you when you step on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/6b44b0aa214bf181ea8d10a2a64abec292b4ae02.png

Pet system

 Added the Eggs system! You can now find eggs in optional quests and use them to summon pets.
 Added a new UI to see your pet's stats.
 Added a new UI to feed your pet. Feeding pets increases their stats permanently. You can feed your pet once per level.
 Pet can now gain experience up to level 20.
 Added a new dialog for pets allowing you to command them (stay, follow, mount)
 Blue slimes can now be mounted.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/1cec0771efb2d0c48fc580674c05f501f595b312.png

Bow

 Added the bow animations
 You can now aim and hold to do more damage with the bow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/6a226af65d223505d59625fae2c78e1c0bc38802.png

Other changes

 Increased effects volume max value
 Bonuses to all effects will now be labeled 'Bonus damage' instead of 'Chaos bonus'
 Added the following items in the crafting table:
 Bow: "Wood"+"Branches"
 Wooden Sword: "Wood"+"Wooden plank"
 Reworked the character selection scene.

Bugs

notes.title: Patch notes 0.3a
notes.content:
The game is shaping up to be what I had envisioned and I'm very excited to share it with you!
This patch focuses on one of the core aspects of Loya: Crafting and survival. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/ac1ab8a8e2b8c8ee4c184729c2fbbf65bdc50f18.jpg

Gameplay

 You now play around your base, it allows you to unlock items, classes and can move around!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/5f2e8e5d7090b96d5a4cb677bda57fcc1763fab6.jpg
 You no longer lose anything when your character dies, you respawn in your bed or in the starting point. Dying too many times in a row triggers a timer (max 1min wait)


World

 The procedural world map has been re-enabled, the biomes generation system has been improved.
 The snow and desert biomes now do ice and fire damage to you. You need to be shletered to not take damage from elements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/82be13e66490e95b37b843b2e3cc44d8c351cc77.jpg
 Changed night lighting to be pitch black, you will now need torches to see. There is now a limit to how many torches you can place in the same spot (for performances)
 You can now accelerate time by sleeping on a bed, you will also regenerate hp faster if a campfire is on nearby.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/55bcb5ad932b849c6ef80a095e75b1c6083c3e1a.jpg
 You can now punch trees to get wood (slowly)
 Natural caves can spawn in the forest and ice biomes (mushroom caves, ice caves), they are considered separate biomes with different monsters and collectibles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/d7975ad849be6dd719da9b0e25fe758ca4bcc7bf.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/f3d2dc4e03c1709a0bf23c6b0cda5db96dc35c25.jpg
 Every destroyed collectible is now saved, making the changes to the world persistent.


Monsters waves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/da8f28427fed14de02c5a3ae557cd4c6a545311b.jpg

 Monsters now attack your base on different events such as reaching a certain base tier or level.
 Monsters will attack you if you start collecting resources around them.
 Building around monster spawners will now make them attack your buildings.
 An interface shows you when the next wave will attack


Classes

 Classes can be unlocked in a new building: the Altar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/c19460f1239a6a8c27386859228c4355a6cdab03.jpg
 Added a new system that allows you to unlock/change classes in exchange for items or tasks.
 You also need specific items to unlock skills for your classes.


Building System

Added new buildings:

  Core: Your main building, allows you to build other structures around it, can be upgraded and can walk at tier 2. 
  Auto Turret: High single target damage.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/436b933126c6c9695caea387705255938310d17b.jpg
  Canon turret: Deals splash damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/7bc8a778df74d4c00009ff9d42caf64821c0e6b9.jpg
  Healing Machine: Heals surrounding entities, drains energy.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/15473b8dbf3245e5f3c590ca5ca016cbd1689f24.jpg
  Altar: Allows you to unlock classes (out of 4 avaliable classes + fishing) and change your main class. Also allows you to unlock new skills for your class.
  Wooden beam: a large beam that you can place on the roofs.
  Wooden roof edge: a roof part for the edges of your buildings.

 You are no longer allowed to build in the ground outside of the starting biome. You have to use your walking base.
 Added a new item: Repair hammer


New food system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/00c75bd39ca2a0af0df8b2ad785b2bf5b56264ce.jpg

 Depending on what you eat, you get different bonuses that last 5minutes. 
 You can only have one bonus type at a time. The bonus types are "Well Fed" and "Well Hydrated"
 Your hunger bar needs to be at 90% for you to get a bonus.


Glider
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/549392c59c61168b55ee41eb04d5af0488b50108.jpg

 Added a Paraglider, uses the trinket slot. Can be crafted with a crafting table.
 The glider drains stamina, and uses inertia to move.


Items
Procedural items: Stats now depend on the item's slot. Sword have damage type stats, shield defensive stats etc...
Added 5 new items that a used to unlock classes and craft items:

 Arcane dust (obtained by mining underwater)
 Fire dust (obtained by mining in desert areas)
 Nature dust (obtained by mining in autumn biome)
 Ice dust (obtained by mining in ice biome)
 Shadow dust (obtained by killing undeads)
 Lightning dust (obtained by killing lightning monsters)


Added new ingredients:

 Ice flower
 Sand
 Empty potion


Forge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/1cf43c4ea33edaa5c20c07843f305178b786d355.jpg

 You can now make items with the forge using ingots and ingredients to define their stats.
 Added a new minigame for the forge. The quality of the item depends on how well you did in the forge. You can reforge items at no cost to try and improve them.


Interface
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/b81f4f0858e3c063036360deb213a9b20447a08e.jpg

 Reworked the interaction UI, you now only have to press your "Use" key to interact with an entity, if the entity has other options, they will be displayed in an other interaction UI with click.
 Added a new UI that shows mana and state for turrets.
 Added a progress bar that shows casts for all entities.
 Buffs and Dots are now easier to see, and have been moved to the upper right side of the screen.
 Improved the building UI interface. It handles non flat surfaces and empty areas properly.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/c37b1c4170923def7e5d5d0215a236ef4c9992ab.jpg
 Added a new UI to track your core's state (hp, supply, energy)
 Added a new UI that tells you what the state of the active raid is (if any)
 Increased the crafting table UI size.
 Added a new UI when you sleep, shows a clock


Other{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/a53d8df14647959fa8c055dc1ecedad44a0293bb.jpg

 Added a new playable character model: Mushrooms!
 Enabled the male character model and fixed his bones alignement on run.
 The crafting table items can now require more that one type of component to be cratfed.
 Added a new tutorial quest type for the starting phase.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/0169c106381a50c66ca612e199f13ce7fcec2fe6.jpg
 Reduced performance costs related to shadow and grass.
 You can now reduce grass density and cloud quality.
 Improved the punch animation and range.
 Added a new slot for trinkets


Bugs

 Fixed a bug where placing building in a plaform that had an angle would ignore that angle.
 Fixed a bug where you would attack after closing game UIs
 Fixed a bug where deleted entities would come back when restarting the server.
 Fixed a bug with boar charges not looking at the right direction.
 Fixed a bug where some enemies would stop attacking in combat.
 FIxed a bug with monsters Y position and floating islands.
 Fixed an exploit where leaving minerals in a furnace and restarting the server would allow it to be melted for ever.

notes.title: Loya Game Patch Notes - Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Greetings, Loya Players!

This patch includes several improvements, bug fixes, and new features that I hope will greatly enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s a summary of what’s new and improved:

Classes and Skills
Warrior Class Update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/6e07af411d76a2b641163221b3e0abbb4d4f74fa.jpg

Introducing a brand-new ultimate ability for warriors, Sun dance, increases the warrior's attack range and deals fire damage.
Revisited and retained the original design for the warrior's 3rd hit.
Skill Tooltips:

Updated skill tooltips for charged spells to correctly display the hotkey.
Corrected alignment issues in mage skill tooltips.

Water Mechanics
Enhanced Water Interactions:
Overhauled the underwater controller for a more fluid experience.
Reworked main floating controller for smoother movement in water.
Fixed issues with water effects not appearing correctly.
Added a Water bar that depletes underwater, with death occurring at 0.
Sound Adjustments
Balanced Audio Effects:
Adjusted potion sound effects for better audio quality.
Eliminated the hit sound on snail encounters for more realistic combat sounds.
Production Bug Fixes
Critical Solutions:

Resolved a significant issue with saving in build mode local server; game now performs an auto-save every 10 seconds.
Fixed multiplayer playability issues related to Steam and data packet handling.
Ensured that characters now correctly start with 3 lives.
Addressed a bug where skills would disappear and become unusable under certain conditions.
Corrected the persistence of BuildingBlocks after destruction.
Other Important Fixes:

Fixed the game not starting in fullscreen mode despite the setting being enabled.
Solved an issue with the Fog of War not resetting correctly after a game over.
Resolved a bug causing the TooltipUI to display inadvertently when picking up items.
Improved overall game performance, particularly focusing on resolving micro freezes.
UI and Quality of Life Improvements
UI Enhancements:

Increased quest tracker font size for better visibility.
Added customizable HUD elements, including player and target HP bars.
Implemented an autorun key for easier navigation.
Upgraded the minimap with zoom in/out functionality and settings memory.
Inventory and Key Bindings:

Fixed item stacking issues to ensure proper functionality.
Resolved an issue with reassigning the key binding for the roll action.
As a solo developer, I am committed to making Loya an immersive and enjoyable experience for all players. Your feedback and support are invaluable to the game's ongoing development and improvement.

Enjoy your adventures in Loya!

Warm regards,
The Creator of Loya

notes.title: Update 1.2alpha
notes.content:
Gameplay update!

It has been a while! But the game was being worked on pretty heavily!

The new patch aims to improve the game's action and rpg aspects, with clear content and objectives, a new quest system, reworked classes, improved combat and enemy AI.

It also brings Roguelite elements to the game with permanent Upgrades, and a GameOver after 3 deaths.

The changes should make the game much more choice oriented and more replayable.
Those who already have a key can test the build, for the others, i'll organize a playtest soon.

Detailed changes:

New quest system

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/2e31808b7b0df9f4605fcf32413ecc5dedad36b4.jpg
You can track every active and avaliable quest in the minimap and the world map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/ee13782fff5f9bff0cf7ef8d4a20310a4f7253ed.png
The quest details are also displayed in the map UI.

Chosen rewards

You can now select from multiple procedurally generate rewards when you complete a quest

30 new quests have been added. Making the first Region fully playable.

New death system:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/4c9e3fa2120a598ea8b434bf20a9011e0ecdffa2.png. 
You now start with 3 lives, if you lose them, it's a GameOver and your character is reset. You can then choose a class again.
Killing strong monsters rewards you with additional lives.

Reworked classes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/41ecf723fcd76cde4731c113760c498eaefc481d.jpg
- The Fire Mage now has a new autotargeted fireball skill that they can charge, consuming energy and doing more damage the more you charge it.
- The Warrior now has the Whirlwind skill, a channelled skill that consumes energy and does damage around the caster.

New world editor!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/8a029834756a1b102e4a966a987c4e78ad026b6a.jpg
A new world editor was made to allow anyone to create quests/maps/skills etc... The editor gives control over the procedurally generated terrain, villages, roads, rivers and any other aspect of the game.

New dungeon system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/90494aee51106aedabbda88701fe5b97142b636d.jpg
The new world editor also features a new dungeon editor, allowing the mechanics such as traps, triggers and dungeon rooms with spawners.

Monsters
Added new monsters such as the Giant snail, the purple lighting slimes. Other bosses have been reworked and improved such as:
- Huge slime (now has a charge)
- Skeleton defender
- Huge mushroom
- Huge purple slime (has lighting orbs)

Ennemy AI:
- Aimed spells are now preaimed and sometimes randomized to try and mimic a human hitting a skillshots
- Some npcs have specific behaviour patterns using a new AI pattern system.

Combat system changes
- Your energy restores very fast when out of combat.
- In combat, you only restore energy by standing still or taking damage.

Building system
- You are now only allowed to build in specific areas, where there are no monster spawners or points of interest

Other changes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/da98b3fb37ab6064224699e5e7a8b02d41030967.jpg
- Improved Fog
- Improved villages
- Improved grass shader, should be less invasive
- Head Equipements such as hats or helmets now hide hairs properly.

Also lots of bug fixes, and UI improvements.

I'll keep working hard until I feel the game is ready for release. There will be multiple test phases before that. 

Thank you for following this project!

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.109a
notes.content:
## Patch notes: **1.109a**

- Remote connections will now use Steam’s **SteamNetworkingSockets**, that uses a relay server allowing anyone to host a world.
- Connection status will now be displayed with a popup (on disconnection or when waiting for a connection)
- Improved villagers models
- Villagers should no longer float.
- Villagers should now properly sleep in their bed and not on the floor.
- You will no longer be able to build on a road.
- Fixed a bug where you would not see your friends in the world selection UI
- Fixed a bug with torches where you would not keep them equipped after placing them on the ground.

- Reworked the Building System:
    - Snapping points will now be visible helping you understand where and why your object is snapping.
    - Blocs will be rotated before applying snapping, improving rotation behavior.
    - Moved the camera to the right while placing blocs.
    - Added a crosshair while placing blocs, helping you target snapping points.
    - Added a new long roof building bloc
    
    *Overall, The building system reword fixed a lot of issues, but all existing buildings will be affected by these changes, breaking the way they looked.* 
    {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/29bfb433f9b86258c5d2ab5dc9eb15d43fec1055.png
- Added the propellers system:
    - Propellers make the walking base lift up when activated.
    - Propellers drain energy from your base when they are on.
- Added the sails system:
    - Sails allow you to move while flying depending on wind strength/direction.
- You can now see the energy levels of the walking platform you are on.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43644417/efafb5f16bdca746cf9c783aa59ee2827217b7e4.png
Bugfixes:

- Fixed a bug where you would not be able to learn any recipe for the crafting table.
- Fixed a bug with roofs and stairs where they could not be used as a snapping target.
- Fixed a bug where rotation would not properly snap with building blocs.
- Fixed a bug with levers that would not properly work with some components.
